# DHDTech.io Design

> DHDTech.io Design is a free, self-hosted instance of Penpot — the open-source design and prototyping platform — hosted by DHDTech.io.

## What this is

- [Penpot](https://github.com/penpot/penpot): the open-source design and prototyping platform this instance runs; licensed MPL-2.0 and maintained by the Penpot community.
- [Welcome page](https://design.dhdtech.io/welcome): what DHDTech.io Design is, who it is for, and what it costs.

## Use it

- [DHDTech.io Design](https://design.dhdtech.io/): create a free account and design or prototype in the browser.

## Credits

- [Penpot community](https://penpot.app): the project this instance is built on, and where its community gathers.
